prompts.text: Name the capital city of an Asian country

items.title: Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte
items.extract: Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte, also known as Kotte, is the legislative capital city of Sri Lanka. Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte is located adjacent to the urban area of Sri Lanka's de facto economic capital, Colombo.

items.title: Eresus
items.extract: Eresus, also called ladybird spiders, is a genus of velvet spiders that was first described by Charles Athanase Walckenaer in 1805. Members of the genus formerly called Eresus cinnaberinus or Eresus niger are now placed in one of three species: Eresus kollari, Eresus sandaliatus and Eresus moravicus. A new species Eresus urus, was discovered in southern Iraq in March 2025.

items.title: Shooter's sandwich
items.extract: The shooter's sandwich is a steak sandwich consisting of cooked steak and mushrooms placed inside a hollowed-out loaf of bread and then weighted down. This popular English sandwich is likened to beef Wellington using bread rather than pastry.

items.title: Carol Burnett
items.extract: Carol Creighton Burnett is an American comedian, actress, singer and writer. Burnett has played dramatic and comedic roles on stage and screen. She has received numerous awards and accolades, including five Golden Globe Awards, a Grammy Award, seven Primetime Emmy Awards, twelve People's Choice Awards, two Peabody Awards. Burnett was honored with a Special Tony Award in 1969, Star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 1975, the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2005, the Mark Twain Prize for American Humor in 2013, the Screen Actors Guild Life Achievement Award in 2015, and the inaugural Golden Globe Carol Burnett Award in 2019.

prompts.text: Name a cryptid (a creature like Bigfoot whose existence is claimed but unproven)

items.title: Tatzelwurm
items.extract: In the folklore of the Alpine region of south-central Europe, the Tatzelwurm, Stollenwurm, or Stollwurm is a lizard-like creature, essentially a sort of dragon, often described as having the face of a cat and a serpent-like body which may be slender or stubby. It is further described as having either four short legs or two forelegs with no hindlimbs, the latter a trait shared with many lindworms. Stories of essentially the same creature also exist in the folklore of South Sweden.

prompts.text: Name a sport played with a racquet or paddle

items.title: Road tennis
items.description: Variation of tennis invented in Barbados
items.extract:
Road tennis is a variation of tennis invented in Barbados in the 1930s by primarily local working class Barbadians who could not afford to play lawn tennis.
Though mainly concentrated in the island nation of Barbados, it has been since further introduced to California and the wider Caribbean. It is often played on public residential roads or at schools, community centres and recreational areas around the island where most road tennis courts are located, either on asphalt or concrete pavement surfaces.

items.title: Gentile da Fabriano
items.extract: Gentile da Fabriano was an Italian painter known for his participation in the International Gothic pictorial style. He worked in various places in central Italy, mostly in Tuscany.
